wildhunt.skill.storm_crown.description: Railbolt ricochets between enemies within twelve blocks without revisiting a target. Thunder Step follows your aim through a clear 3D path and shocks enemies along it. Toggle Storm Mantle for movement, attack speed and lightning power. Damage improves with mastery, never with EP. Master this skill to unlock its Ultimate as Sovereign Hunter.
